### [`engine_cutoff_down`](../../../../src/sound/sound_update_48e0.asm#L6) `$48E0`

*routine*

Lowers the filter cutoff of the engine sound ($ac, $d416) by 1, to at least $10. The enemy sound code at $5ef8 calls it.
